Meta.title: Nyay.ai: Talk to a verified advocate
Meta.description: Describe your legal problem in Hindi or English and consult a verified advocate in Uttar Pradesh or Delhi. Pay only for the minutes you use.

Hero.title: Tell us what happened.
Hero.subtitle: In Hindi, English or both. We’ll find a verified advocate who practises in your court.

Hero.placeholder2: मेरे चेक का भुगतान नहीं हुआ…

Analysis.title: Document analysis
Analysis.heading: Upload a legal document
Analysis.subtitle: See which clauses of a notice, FIR or contract deserve a closer look before you speak to an advocate.
Analysis.dropHint: FIR, legal notice, contract or agreement
Analysis.formats: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB
Analysis.consent: I agree to Nyay.ai processing this document. It is encrypted in transit and deleted after 30 days.
Analysis.badType: Please choose a PDF, JPG or PNG file.
Analysis.tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB.
Analysis.secure: Encrypted in transit. Deleted after 30 days.
Analysis.previewNote: Preview. Your own file is not read yet: this is a sample analysis of a fictional lease.
Analysis.scoreHow: Each high-risk clause adds 22 points and each clause to review adds 7, up to 100. It counts flagged clauses. It is not a prediction and not legal advice.
Analysis.standardWhy: This wording is common in agreements of this kind.
Analysis.standardAsk: No question needed unless you want it explained.
Analysis.disclaimer: Automated analysis. It points to wording worth a second look and does not say what is lawful or what you should do.

revision.title: Rent increase
revision.why: A rise of up to 25% can start immediately, with no notice period.
revision.ask: Is a notice period and a cap on increases usual here, and can I ask for one?

deposit.title: Security deposit
deposit.why: The deposit can be kept for any reason, and nothing is said about returning it.
deposit.ask: Under what conditions should the deposit come back, and can that be written in?

entry.title: Owner's entry
entry.why: The owner may enter at any time without telling the tenant.
entry.ask: Should entry need advance notice, and at what times of day?

repairs.title: Repairs
repairs.why: The tenant pays for every kind of repair, including ordinary wear and structural work.
repairs.ask: Which repairs are normally the owner's responsibility?

early.title: Leaving early
early.why: Leaving early means paying all the remaining months in full.
early.ask: Can this be reduced to a fixed notice period or a smaller payment?
